1 // bin/contract.mjs — Wave 1 frozen contract surface + import GO/NO-GO spike.
2 //
3 // researchPrime's upgrade IMPORTS, never forks, the trio's machinery
4 // (MASTER-PLAN "Architecture"; DESCRIPTION "What is being built"). This module is the
5 // REAL source that the contract test exercises: it pins the exact on-disk modules and
6 // the exact SYMBOLS researchPrime crosses out of each one, performs the smoke import
7 // from researchPrime's own directory, and verifies every crossed symbol is present with
8 // the expected kind.
9 //
10 // GO/NO-GO (IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN Wave 1 / MASTER-PLAN Phase 0): if the smoke import
11 // succeeds and every crossed symbol resolves, the trio surface is GO and researchPrime
12 // builds on it directly. If any crossed symbol is missing/renamed, the contract test
13 // goes RED — that is the NO-GO signal routing to Phase 0.5 (owned trio-core extraction),
14 // NOT a license to fork. This module is the single source of truth for the crossed-symbol
15 // list (recorded in human-readable form in CONTRACT-SURFACE.md).
16 
17 import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
18 import path from 'node:path';
19 
20 // ── Trio root: the ONE pinned external dependency ─────────────────────────────
21 // researchPrime imports the trio's LIVE source, which lives OUTSIDE this repo — so that
22 // location is the single external dependency the contract takes on. Rather than scatter
23 // five hard-coded `../../` escapes (each an implicit, unpinned reach out of the repo), the
24 // dependency is pinned in ONE place: TRIO_ROOT. By default it resolves to the sibling tree
25 // under the shared parent (C:/dev/{crucible,foreman}), relative to this file (bin/), so the
26 // smoke import still proves the trio loads "from researchPrime/" exactly as Wave 1 requires.
27 // A hermetic build (CI, a pinned checkout) can override the root via RP_TRIO_ROOT to point
28 // at an exact, version-pinned copy instead of relying on the ambient sibling layout — the
29 // non-hermetic default is then a convenience, not a hard-wired assumption.
30 export const TRIO_ROOT = process.env.RP_TRIO_ROOT
31   ? pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.env.RP_TRIO_ROOT) + path.sep)
32   : new URL('../../', import.meta.url);
33 
34 // ── Module map ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
35 // Specifiers are resolved RELATIVE TO TRIO_ROOT (above), so changing the pin moves all
36 // five modules together and the smoke import follows.

43 };

96 // Resolve a module specifier against the pinned trio root (so resolution tracks the pin).
97 function resolveSpec(spec) {
98   return new URL(spec, TRIO_ROOT);
99 }
100 
101 /**
102  * Smoke-import every trio module from researchPrime's directory.
103  * @returns {Promise<Record<string, object>>} map of module key → its namespace object.
104  * Rejects (propagating the loader error) if any module fails to load — that rejection IS
105  * the NO-GO signal the contract test surfaces.
106  */
107 export async function importTrioSurface() {
108   const surface = {};
109   for (const [key, spec] of Object.entries(TRIO_MODULES)) {
110     surface[key] = await import(resolveSpec(spec));
111   }
112   return surface;
113 }
114 
115 /**
116  * Verify the imported surface against the frozen crossed-symbol list.
117  * @param {Record<string, object>} surface output of importTrioSurface()
118  * @returns {{ ok: boolean, missing: Array<{module:string,name:string,kind:string,reason:string}> }}
119  * `missing` is empty on GO; each entry is a renamed/dropped/mis-kinded symbol on NO-GO.
120  */
121 export function verifyContractSurface(surface) {
122   const missing = [];
123   for (const [mod, symbols] of Object.entries(CROSSED_SYMBOLS)) {
124     const ns = surface[mod];
125     if (!ns) {
126       missing.push({ module: mod, name: '*', kind: 'namespace', reason: 'module did not import' });
127       continue;
128     }
129     for (const { name, kind } of symbols) {
130       if (!(name in ns) || ns[name] === undefined) {
131         missing.push({ module: mod, name, kind, reason: 'symbol absent' });
132         continue;
133       }
134       // Strict, symmetric kind check. 'function' must be callable; 'value' must be a
135       // present, non-callable export ('function' covers classes too, so a class tagged
136       // 'value' is correctly rejected, and a null export is not a real value). An unknown
137       // declared kind is a bug in CROSSED_SYMBOLS itself — fail loudly rather than let a
138       // typo'd kind ('values', 'val', …) silently pass every check.
139       const actual = ns[name] === null ? 'null' : typeof ns[name];
140       if (kind === 'function') {
141         if (actual !== 'function') {
142           missing.push({ module: mod, name, kind, reason: `expected function, got ${actual}` });
143         }
144       } else if (kind === 'value') {
145         if (actual === 'function' || actual === 'null') {
146           missing.push({ module: mod, name, kind, reason: `expected value, got ${actual}` });
147         }
148       } else {
149         missing.push({ module: mod, name, kind, reason: `unknown declared kind: ${kind}` });
150       }
151     }
152   }
153   return { ok: missing.length === 0, missing };
154 }
155 
156 /**
157  * Run the full GO/NO-GO spike: import + verify. Returns a structured verdict.
158  * @returns {Promise<{ go: boolean, modules: string[], crossedCount: number, missing: object[] }>}
159  */
160 export async function runImportSpike() {
161   const surface = await importTrioSurface();
162   const { ok, missing } = verifyContractSurface(surface);
163   const crossedCount = Object.values(CROSSED_SYMBOLS).reduce((n, s) => n + s.length, 0);
164   return { go: ok, modules: Object.keys(TRIO_MODULES), crossedCount, missing };
165 }
166 
167 // Convenience for human inspection / CLI: `node bin/contract.mjs`.
168 if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
169   const verdict = await runImportSpike();
170   console.log(JSON.stringify(verdict, null, 2));
171   process.exit(verdict.go ? 0 : 1);
172 }
